tuning_key.text: When we are little ones / We have questions about how things are done / Is there a rule of thumb / On how to find happiness and love / With freedom
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The questions you asked at five never wanted a rulebook answer. Step one inch off the efficient path and let the bright variance become the purpose.

practice.title: Unclench the Map
practice.instruction: Soften your jaw and let your shoulders drop half an inch below where they think they should be.

practice.title: Irregular Rhythm
practice.instruction: Tap your fingers against your thigh in three uneven beats, letting the last one land later than your muscle expects.

practice.title: Press Play
practice.instruction: Press play on the Echo audio and let your body receive the bright scatter without reaching for the pattern.
